description: This file contains function declarations and internal implementations for converting strings to numbers, including integer, floating-point, and hexadecimal conversions, as well as related utility functions within the Abseil library.

classes.name: numbers_internal
classes.description: Namespace containing internal helper functions and constants for number conversions.

methods.name: PutTwoDigits
methods.description: Writes a two-character string representation of an integer in the range 0-99 into a buffer.

methods.name: safe_strto32_base
methods.description: Converts a string to a 32-bit signed integer with specified base, internal helper.

methods.name: safe_strto64_base
methods.description: Converts a string to a 64-bit signed integer with specified base, internal helper.

methods.name: safe_strto128_base
methods.description: Converts a string to a 128-bit signed integer with specified base, internal helper.

methods.name: safe_strtou32_base
methods.description: Converts a string to a 32-bit unsigned integer with specified base, internal helper.

methods.name: safe_strtou64_base
methods.description: Converts a string to a 64-bit unsigned integer with specified base, internal helper.

methods.name: safe_strtou128_base
methods.description: Converts a string to a 128-bit unsigned integer with specified base, internal helper.

methods.name: SixDigitsToBuffer
methods.description: Formats a double into a buffer with six significant digits, similar to printf's %g.

methods.name: FastIntToBuffer
methods.description: Fast integer to string conversion for 32-bit and 64-bit integers.

methods.name: safe_strtoi_base
methods.description: Generalized internal function to convert string to integer with specified base.
